mapper.select: SELECT A.MENU_ID, A.PG_ID, A.MENU_GROUP, A.MENU_NAME, A.M_LEVEL, A.LEVEL_ORDER, A.UP_MENU_ID, A.FORM_URL, B.FORM_USE FROM (SELECT S1.MENU_ID, S1.PG_ID, S1.MENU_GROUP, S1.MENU_NAME, S1.M_LEVEL, S1.LEVEL_ORDER, S1.UP_MENU_ID, S1.FORM_URL, S1.FORM_USE FROM dbo.TPM_MENU S1 WHERE S1.FORM_USE = '1' AND S1.MENU_GROUP = #{MENU_GROUP} UNION ALL SELECT S2.MENU_ID, S2.PG_ID, S2.MENU_GROUP, S2.MENU_NAME, S2.M_LEVEL, S2.LEVEL_ORDER, S2.UP_MENU_ID, S2.FORM_URL, S2.FORM_USE FROM dbo.TPM_MENU_ADD S2 WHERE S2.FORM_USE = '1' AND S2.OFFICE_CODE = #{LOGIN_OFFICE_CODE} AND S2.MENU_GROUP = #{MENU_GROUP}) A LEFT JOIN dbo.TPM_USERMENU B ON A.MENU_ID = B.MENU_ID AND B.USER_ID = #{LOGIN_ID} WHERE (B.FORM_USE = '1') ORDER BY A.MENU_ID
